rule: ICON is a UI role, not an asset classification. IMPLEMENTATION_READY_UI remains blocked until each required visible icon/brand mark is mapped to an actual production asset or an explicitly authorized exact package export.

genericIconSourcePolicy.candidateFamily: Lucide outline consistent with approved design system
genericIconSourcePolicy.notes: Final source/version and destinationPath must be frozen in asset-manifest before readiness.

brandMarkSourcePolicy.notes: Identity-bearing marks require exact brand mapping; generic icon packages are not acceptable substitutes.

completionCriteria: every required generic icon has an actual vector source/export and destinationPath
every identity-bearing brand mark has an exact approved source and mapping
asset-manifest contains all required iconInventory entries
each required iconInventory id resolves to an asset with role=ICON where applicable; brand marks retain role=LOGO
